affected_predicate.description: All visible toots tagged #dogs are favorited exactly when they are not already in the favorite or bookmark list.

competing_trace_defects.description: Starting at step 7, the agent treats an unselected favorite star as sufficient permission to favorite a toot, without visibly checking whether the toot is already bookmarked as required by the instruction.

From step 15 onward, the agent repeatedly performs the same upward drag while remaining on the same Golden Retriever post, continuing through the last observable step without changing strategy or reaching additional toots.

chains.rationale: The reused observation contains a false date/weekday assertion, but the target uses the prior search-selection history only to interpret the current #dogs feed and scroll it. The target screen already visibly contains a #dogs post, and later steps visibly favorite several posts, so the erroneous date claim does not create, preserve, or amplify a defect affecting conditional favoriting. The predicate is only partially observable: several stars visibly change to the favorited state, but the agent never visibly verifies bookmark status and becomes stuck repeatedly scrolling the same post, so completion for all eligible toots is not established.

summary: The reused history's false date/weekday detail is visibly irrelevant to the target's feed-scrolling action and is merely concurrent with the task predicate. Independent defects are the absence of bookmark-status verification before favoriting and a prolonged ineffective scroll loop that remains on the same post through the terminal trace.
